scripts.install: for dir in */; do (cd "$dir" && npm install) || exit 1; done
scripts.build: for dir in */; do (cd "$dir" && npm run check --if-present && npm run build --if-present && npm test --if-present) || exit 1; done
scripts.build:deps: for dir in */; do (cd "$dir" && npm run build:deps --if-present) || exit 1; done
